name: FlameKit
description: One toolkit, many features (F6 opens its window). Auto Junk List: junk is dropped or deleted when you loot it. Minimap: a round map of the ground around you (needs the FlameKit Native part, in your game only). Experimental: each player's own switches (no shroud damage, no fall damage, invincible mode, unlimited stamina, enhanced glider) and two travel buttons. On a dedicated server, install FlameKit on the server and in your game.

settings.label: Key that opens FlameKit's window
settings.help: FlameKit's own window: the Auto Junk List, the other features' tabs, Settings and What's New. The same key or Esc closes it.

settings.label: Hold this key to get the mouse pointer for FlameKit's pinned windows
settings.help: While it is held the pinned windows (Party, Messages) can be moved, resized, collapsed and hidden, and the game gets no input. Caps Lock also switches capital letters on and off each time.

settings.label: Show FlameKit's messages (the Messages window)
settings.help: What a feature just did, for example "Junk discarded: Twigs x3", in FlameKit's Messages window for a few seconds (hold the pointer key to see the last ones).

settings.label: Open FlameKit's window when you enter a world
settings.help: It opens on the What's New tab. After an update it opens once by itself anyway.

settings.label: Remove junk as soon as you loot it
settings.help: Off: junk stays until you press Dump junk (the panel's button or the key below).

settings.label: What happens to junk
settings.help: IMPORTANT for dropping: turn off "Auto-Collect Scattered Loot" in the game settings, or the game picks dropped junk straight back up. Deleted junk is gone: there is no undo.

settings.label: Dump Key
settings.help: No key by default, so nothing is deleted by a stray key press.

settings.label: Exclude Action Bar
settings.help: On: items on your action bar are never junked, even if they are on your junk list. Weapons, armour, rings, tools and summoning items are never junked wherever they are (unless Show All Bag Items is on).

settings.label: Show All Bag Items
settings.help: Off (the default): weapons, armour, shields, rings, amulets, tools, summoning items, blueprints, trophies, runes and pieces of gear with their own level and perks are never junk, so they are not offered in the bag list, and one already on your junk list is left alone. On: every item in your bag is offered and can be junked, including valuable high level gear. Junked items are dropped or deleted like any other junk, so be careful with Delete.

settings.label: Key that shows and hides the minimap
Zoom (0 closest, 6 farthest; also the zoom keys and the Minimap tab)
Show undiscovered map locations
settings.help: In grey with a small question mark, in the shape of the game's own icon for what is there. A spoiler: off unless you switch it on.

settings.label: Minimaps larger than Large magnify the map
settings.help: Off: a minimap bigger than Large shows more of the world, with the map, the icons and the text as big as on Large. On: it shows the same piece of the world, with everything bigger (for very high screen resolutions).

settings.label: Marker kinds that are switched off
settings.help: Set from the Minimap tab of the FlameKit panel (its Marker filters): short names with commas between, - for none.

settings.label: Display map marker labels while zoomed in
settings.help: Under the markers at all but the two farthest zoom steps, in small letters: the game's own names for places (in English), the names you gave your own markers, and the names players gave to flame altars near you.

settings.label: Show the clock under the minimap
settings.help: The time of day, and how many minutes are left until night or day.

settings.label: Show your altitude at the end of the clock line
settings.help: How high you are, in metres: useful while gliding, climbing and digging.

settings.label: Show where you are under the minimap
settings.help: The region (for example Springlands: the one whose Ancient Spire is nearest) and under it the named place you are in, or else the nearest one you have found (a village, a lake, a camp, a flame altar) while it is within the minimap's view; nothing when none is that close.

settings.label: Hide the minimap while the big map, the bag or any menu is open
settings.help: The big map, the bag and every other screen that shows the mouse pointer.

settings.label: Place across the screen (0 left to 1000 right; -1: use the corner below)
Place down the screen (0 top to 1000 bottom; -1: use the corner below)
Show FlameKit mod version
settings.help: On by default. Switch it off to take the label off your screen; FlameKit keeps working.
